limitations: Counts describe the closed fixture grammar, not arbitrary browser DOM semantics.
A zero applies only to analysed complete-interface rows; legacy rows are unanalysed.
Coverage does not establish model accuracy, calibrated confidence or real-user impact.

diagnosis.observed: Candidate reproduces the closed v3 validation behavior on all 2560 recovered rows, but fails 11 of 24 independently authored challenge requests. Six failures concern explicit-label semantics or form scope; five concern Italian summary scope. Two automatic passes also have narrative/action-quality issues.
diagnosis.most_likely_mechanism: Limited structural coverage in the complete-interface training grammar. Physically missing targets dominate insufficient-evidence supervision; moved targets and requested subsets with same-form decoys are absent. This is a supported hypothesis, not a causal ablation.
diagnosis.native_contract: All 2608 recovered outputs are complete native-schema/domain-valid responses. Structured-output validity does not establish semantic correctness.
diagnosis.recommended_next_step: Finish the frozen qualification and preserve all outputs. Prepare a versioned, targeted development curriculum for scope and property counterfactuals, then evaluate a small pilot before considering a larger retraining run.

next_development_protocol.challenge_after_diagnosis_role: Known development regression set for any subsequent model influenced by these findings; do not call it an unseen holdout again.
coverage_requirements: Cross target location with property state: inside selected form, outside with no ownership, and explicitly form-associated only when the task permits it.
Cross selected-form presence with requested-target presence. Include named targets elsewhere when the selected form is absent.
Contrast implicit wrapping labels with explicit for-linked labels under tasks that clearly specify which property is required.
Select only a subset of same-form controls; vary correct and defective unrequested decoys independently of requested targets.
Use balanced English and Italian task paraphrases and scoped summaries; assess recommendation relevance and unsupported claims separately from JSON validity.
data_controls: Use newly authored development scenarios; never copy the exact validation/challenge prompts or outputs into training.
Keep all counterfactual and translation siblings in one partition, with held-out service and structure families.
Freeze a fresh independently authored qualification suite before pilot inference; retain final thesis cases untouched.
Audit token lengths and semantic duplication; report structural family counts as well as row counts.
next_development_protocol.pilot_acceptance: Predeclare schema, target, abstention, scope and narrative gates, plus retention checks. Continue only on measured improvement without regression; loss alone cannot authorize scaling or promotion.
next_development_protocol.human_review_needed: Challenge labels, rationale quality and the thesis evaluation interpretation still require human expert review.
